entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former planeswalker, once a human warlord, cursed by the Chain Veil and trapped on Zendikar, who lost his spark in the Great Desparking.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An ancient artifact that cursed Ob Nixilis and turned him into a demon.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A mana-rich plane where Ob Nixilis was trapped and later fought the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Zendikar's self-appointed protector who fused a hedron into Ob Nixilis's forehead.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who struck down Ob Nixilis and extracted the hedron, and later tried to manipulate his mind.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker with invulnerability who dueled Ob Nixilis at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who bested Ob Nixilis at the Khalni Heart and later fought him at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who freed her friends from Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers formed shortly after Nixilis left Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan awakened by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan Gideon's troops tried to imprison in a hedron network.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who went through the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet with Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who distracted Tezzeret.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A character who fought Eternals with Nixilis on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Bolas's servant whose Bridge control mechanism Karn destroyed.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who arrived with Sarkhan to aid the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A rogue planeswalker who arrived with Hazoret.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: The leader of a New Capenna family, killed by Ob Nixilis at the Maestro Museum.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Ob Nixilis followed to a Park Heights cathedral.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who escaped the Crescendo with Elspeth.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane of demonic gang families where Ob Nixilis plotted and was later stranded.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Ob Nixilis was trapped by the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: A source of elemental power on Bala Ged that Ob Nixilis tried to leech.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The conflict with the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Cabaretti Crescendo
entities.description: The night Ob Nixilis ordered his agents to attack the five families of New Capenna.

events.summary: More than a thousand years ago, Ob Nixilis summons demons who kill every living thing on his plane, and his spark ignites.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis's spark ignited while he walked away from his dead plane

events.summary: Ob Nixilis acquires the Chain Veil on Shandalar, which curses him into a demon.
events.quote: but it cursed him and turned him into a demon.

events.summary: Nahiri intercepts Ob Nixilis on Zendikar and fuses a hedron into his forehead, binding his spark and trapping him.
events.quote: This hedron bound his spark , trapping him on the plane

events.summary: Jace takes Nixilis's lure, strikes him down and extracts the hedron to save Garruk, restoring Nixilis's strength.
events.quote: Thus Ob Nixilis regained his strength and could regrow his wings.

events.summary: Nissa bests Ob Nixilis at Bala Ged and removes the Khalni Heart to safety.
events.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

events.summary: At Tazeem Ob Nixilis siphons the hedron network, reigniting his spark, destroys it and awakens Kozilek.
events.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

events.summary: Ob Nixilis defeats Nissa and breaks Jace's cheekbone at Sea Gate.
events.quote: the demon's glancing blow broke Jace's cheekbone and sent him sprawling.

events.summary: Gideon shreds one of the demon's wings; Nixilis pins and drowns him in muddy water.
events.quote: Nixilis then proved that invulnerability was nothing as he proceeded to drown Gideon in the muddy waters at their feet.

events.summary: Nixilis takes Gideon, Jace and Nissa prisoner and tortures them until Chandra frees them and their attack scares him away from Zendikar.
events.quote: Their concerted attack managed to scare the demon away from Zendikar

events.summary: Ob Nixilis is lured to Ravnica and trapped by the Immortal Sun, absorbing the souls of Eternals he kills.
events.quote: He absorbed the souls of the Eternals he killed, fueling his power.

events.summary: Nixilis joins Karn, Dack and Samut to go through the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet; Karn destroys the Bridge mechanism in Tezzeret.
events.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

events.summary: Nixilis incinerates the inactive Eternals and, uninterested in Hazoret's fight against Bolas, planeswalks away.
events.quote: Refusing to go back to the battle on Ravnica, he planeswalked away to safety.

events.summary: On the night of the Cabaretti Crescendo, Ob Nixilis has his agents attack all five families of New Capenna and kills Xander himself.
events.quote: Nixilis himself traveled to the Maestro Museum, killing the family's leader, Xander , personally.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis follows Elspeth, Vivien and the Font to a Park Heights cathedral, is badly wounded and flees.
events.quote: he nearly overcame Tirel before being badly wounded and planeswalking away to safety.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis sits out the New Phyrexian Invasion, then loses his spark and is stranded on New Capenna.
events.quote: Nixilis is now stranded on New Capenna, at the mercy of the five families wanting revenge.

relations.quote: Nahiri , Zendikar's self-appointed protector, intercepted him and fused a small hedron into his forehead.
killing the family's leader, Xander , personally.

relations.note: reluctant partner in the Amonkhet mission
relations.quote: although Nixilis made it clear that he was only helping them because he wanted to escape from Ravnica.
